summary: DarkIris Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held October 6, 2026, in Xiamen, China. Shareholders approved six proposals, including a special resolution increasing Class B voting rights to 200 votes per share and authorizing two conditional 50-for-1 reverse share consolidations, each triggered if the Class A closing price falls below US$1.00 within one year. All proposals passed overwhelmingly. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a deal is stated; this is a routine meeting-result filing.
